d: Job Summary: Responsible for leading the organization's financial strategy, governance, risk management, treasury operations, and financial performance. The CFO will partner with the CEO and Board of Directors to drive sustainable growth, profitability, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance.
q: li
Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
li
MBA preferred; CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or CFA highly preferred.
li
Minimum 15 years of progressive finance leadership experience, including 7 years in a senior role within financial services.
li
Proven expertise in global remittances, money exchange, FX trading, gold and bullion trading, treasury, liquidity management, and payments.
li
Experience dealing with central banks, regulators, correspondent banks, and external auditors.
li
Strong knowledge of IFRS, corporate finance, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
p
Note: We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted
r: Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with business objectives.
Advise the CEO and Board on financial performance, planning, growth, investments, and expansion opportunities.
Oversee accounting, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and performance management.
Ensure accurate financial statements, strong internal controls, and financial governance.
Manage treasury operations, liquidity, cash flow, capital allocation, and banking relationships.
Implement funding and hedging strategies to mitigate currency and commodity risks.
Remittance, Money Exchange, Gold & FX Operations
Oversee financial performance, profitability, pricing, and liquidity across remittance, money exchange, FX, and bullion trading operations.
Manage trading risks, transaction valuation, financial reporting, and related business development initiatives.
Establish risk management frameworks and ensure compliance with AML, KYC, CTF, sanctions screening, and regulatory requirements.
Liaise with regulators, central banks, and auditors, overseeing audit activities and corrective actions.
Lead finance, treasury, and accounting teams, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
Maintain relationships with banks, regulators, investors, and business partners, and present financial recommendations to the Board.

d: The Strategic Data Analyst is a full-time remote role responsible for turning complex data into clear, actionable insights that support business strategy and operational decisions. Day-to-day tasks include collecting and cleaning data from multiple sources, performing quantitative analyses, and building dashboards and reports to track key performance indicators for language services and training programs. The person in this role will develop and maintain data models, perform trend and cohort analyses, and generate forecasts to support strategic planning and resource allocation. They will collaborate with leadership, operations, and sales teams to communicate findings, recommend improvements, and support data-driven initiatives across markets and service lines.
q: li
Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and proven experience in Data Analytics for business decision support.
li
Candidates should possess solid Statistics knowledge for quantitative analysis, forecasting, and performance measurement.
li
Candidates should possess experience in Data Modeling, including designing data structures and building dashboards or reports.
li
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for presenting complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
li
Proficiency with analytics tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, BI platforms such as Power BI or Tableau) and experience working with large datasets.
li
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, or related discipline) or equivalent practical experience.
li
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a global, cross-functional setting.
li
Experience in professional services, education, or language solutions environments is a plus, as is familiarity with A/B testing and basic data visualization best practices.
